_meta.reason: The T1059.001 rule cannot separate a benign encoded command from a malicious one, because both look identical in the command line. Parent-process exclusion was measured and rejected: it removed only 1 of 2 observed false positives, and the remaining false positive shared its parent, image, and command-line shape with the true positives. The only discriminator is the payload itself, so the payload is decoded at ingest and handed to the analyst and to later rules.
_meta.note: Attached as index.final_pipeline so it runs after any integration default pipeline rather than replacing it.

description: Decodes the base64 payload of powershell.exe -EncodedCommand into aegis.powershell.decoded_command

script.description: Scan command-line tokens from the end and decode the first valid UTF-16LE base64 payload
